observation_rules.effective_parameters: Record regions, devices, operators, filters, limits/pagination and all other effective settings actually used
observation_rules.frequency_raw: Actual provider value only; null for absent/error/unknown; zero only for explicit successful zero
observation_rules.period_returned: Record actual source period, or null with explanation; never invent an exact date range
observation_rules.source_path: Sanitized raw evidence in this folder; public repository must never contain credentials or private client records
observation_rules.request_conflict: An identical provider request ID with different response contents is a conflict to investigate
observation_rules.schema_vs_api: These are internal normalized ledger fields, not a claimed Yandex Bridge command schema

schema_notes.scope_rule: A phrase-level rejection is not a topic-level rejection. Low-frequency relevant phrases may be included in a passing topic.
schema_notes.threshold_rules: Null means no finite threshold only when accompanied by reason NO_POSITIVE_CONTRIBUTION; otherwise null is unknown. Store unrounded computed thresholds; ceil only for presentation.
schema_notes.append_only: Never delete old observations/evaluations on reclassification. Use supersedes for an evaluation, prior_observation_id for an authorized remeasurement.
schema_notes.freshness: Every reuse retains the original acquisition date and period; old data must not be relabelled current
schema_notes.new_filter_or_price: Re-evaluate existing observations without making another paid Wordstat call
schema_notes.secrets: Never store keys, tokens, settings backups or private client data
